summary: Feed s056_single is degraded: 22.7% of frames truncated (mostly to 128 bytes) violates NDR full-payload requirement. All other checks (duplicates, encryption, VLANs, one-way, oversize, drops, overload, tunnels) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker slicing/truncation is enabled and cutting frames to ~128 bytes (likely snaplen/slicing policy to save bandwidth). 420 of 1849 frames (22.7%) exceed 5% threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for deep packet inspection, signature matching, and anomaly detection. With only headers/128 bytes, payload-based detections, file extraction, and L7 analysis will fail or produce false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: NDR profile requires needs_full_payload=true. Disable slicing/snaplen on the broker port/policy for s056_single to forward full frames up to 9216 bytes so NDR receives complete payloads.
